hints.tr: Başlangıç kodu yalnızca son yedi günü tutuyor.
hints.en: The starter code keeps only the last seven days.

hints.tr: Üç şarttan biri yeter: `age < 7 or (day.weekday() == 6 and age < 28) or day.day == 1`.
hints.en: One of three conditions is enough: `age < 7 or (day.weekday() == 6 and age < 28) or day.day == 1`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
from datetime import date


def gfs_keep(dates, today):
    now = date.fromisoformat(today)
    kept = []
    for text in dates:
        day = date.fromisoformat(text)
        age = (now - day).days
        weekly = day.weekday() == 6 and age < 28
        if age < 7 or weekly or day.day == 1:
            kept.append(text)
    return sorted(kept)

from datetime import date, timedelta

TODAY = date(2026, 11, 1)
DATES = [(TODAY - timedelta(days=i)).isoformat() for i in range(60)]
kept = gfs_keep(DATES, TODAY.isoformat())
print(len(kept))
for day in kept[:5]:
    print(day)
```

from datetime import date


def gfs_keep(dates, today):
    now = date.fromisoformat(today)
    kept = []
    for text in dates:
        day = date.fromisoformat(text)
        age = (now - day).days
        weekly = day.weekday() == 6 and age < 28
        if age < 7 or weekly or day.day == 1:
            kept.append(text)
    return sorted(kept)

from datetime import date, timedelta

TODAY = date(2026, 11, 1)
DATES = [(TODAY - timedelta(days=i)).isoformat() for i in range(60)]
kept = gfs_keep(DATES, TODAY.isoformat())
print(len(kept))
for day in kept[:5]:
